## Classes

### <a name="unifi"></a>`unifi`

By default the `unifi` package is downloaded from Ubiquiti's download
server for the version in `package_ensure` (`install_from => 'download'`),
because Ubiquiti publishes some releases there before, or instead of, its
APT repository. With `install_from => 'repository'` it comes from the APT
repository's `repo_release` suite instead.

The `unifi` package depends on MongoDB (3.6 up to, not including, 8.1) and
a Java runtime (Java 25 for UniFi 10.4, Java 17 or 21 for 9.x). Neither is
in every distribution's own archive, so the module can add MongoDB's
repository and, where the distribution has no suitable Java, Adoptium's
Temurin repository, and install the Java package first so APT doesn't
pick a full JDK to satisfy the dependency.

The defaults for each OS are in the module's Hiera data.

#### Examples

##### Install the default version (10.6.106) with everything it needs

```puppet
include unifi
```

##### Install another version from the download server

```puppet
class { 'unifi':
  package_ensure => '10.4.57-34628-1',
}
```

##### Use a TLS certificate for the web interface

```puppet
class { 'unifi':
  ssl_certificate => '/etc/ssl/certs/unifi.example.com.pem',
  ssl_private_key => '/etc/ssl/private/unifi.example.com.key',
}
```

##### Follow a release line in Ubiquiti's APT repository

```puppet
class { 'unifi':
  install_from   => 'repository',
  repo_release   => 'unifi-10.4',
  package_ensure => 'latest',
}
```

##### <a name="-unifi--install_from"></a>`install_from`

Data type: `Enum['download', 'repository']`

`download` installs the .deb for `package_ensure` from Ubiquiti's
download server; `repository` installs from the APT repository.

Default value: `'download'`

##### <a name="-unifi--package_url"></a>`package_url`

Data type: `Optional[Stdlib::HTTPUrl]`

The .deb to download. Defaults to Ubiquiti's URL for the version in
`package_ensure`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-unifi--package_checksums"></a>`package_checksums`

Data type: `Hash[String[1], Pattern[/\A\h{64}\z/]]`

SHA-256 checksums of known .deb files, keyed by package version. A
download with a known checksum is verified; others are trusted as
downloaded over HTTPS.

##### <a name="-unifi--download_dir"></a>`download_dir`

Data type: `Stdlib::Absolutepath`

Where the downloaded .deb is kept.

Default value: `'/var/cache/unifi'`

##### <a name="-unifi--manage_repository"></a>`manage_repository`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to add Ubiquiti's APT repository. Defaults to true only when
installing from it.

Default value: `($install_from == 'repository'`

##### <a name="-unifi--repo_location"></a>`repo_location`

Data type: `Stdlib::HTTPUrl`

Ubiquiti's repository URL.

Default value: `'https://dl.ui.com/unifi/debian'`

##### <a name="-unifi--repo_release"></a>`repo_release`

Data type: `String[1]`

The suite to install from: `stable` follows the newest release;
`unifi-10.4`, `unifi-9.5` and so on stay on one release line.

Default value: `'stable'`

##### <a name="-unifi--repo_key_name"></a>`repo_key_name`

Data type: `String[1]`

File name of Ubiquiti's signing key in `/etc/apt/keyrings`.

Default value: `'unifi-repo.gpg'`

##### <a name="-unifi--repo_key_source"></a>`repo_key_source`

Data type: `Stdlib::HTTPUrl`

URL of Ubiquiti's signing key.

Default value: `'https://dl.ui.com/unifi/unifi-repo.gpg'`

##### <a name="-unifi--manage_mongodb_repository"></a>`manage_mongodb_repository`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to add MongoDB's APT repository for `mongodb_version`.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-unifi--mongodb_version"></a>`mongodb_version`

Data type: `String[1]`

The MongoDB release series to add, such as `8.0`. UniFi needs at least
3.6 and less than 8.1.

##### <a name="-unifi--mongodb_repo_location"></a>`mongodb_repo_location`

Data type: `String[1]`

MongoDB's repository URL for this distribution.

##### <a name="-unifi--mongodb_repo_component"></a>`mongodb_repo_component`

Data type: `String[1]`

The repository component: `main` on Debian, `multiverse` on Ubuntu.

##### <a name="-unifi--manage_java_repository"></a>`manage_java_repository`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to add Adoptium's Temurin repository, for distributions whose own

##### <a name="-unifi--java_repo_location"></a>`java_repo_location`

Data type: `Stdlib::HTTPUrl`

Adoptium's repository URL.

Default value: `'https://packages.adoptium.net/artifactory/deb'`

Data type: `Optional[String[1]]`

The Java runtime to install before UniFi, or undef to let APT choose from

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to install the `unifi` package.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-unifi--package_name"></a>`package_name`

Data type: `String[1]`

##### <a name="-unifi--settings"></a>`settings`

Data type: `Hash[String[1], Hash]`

`unifi::setting` resources to declare, keyed by property name, such as
`{ 'unifi.https.port' => { 'value' => '8443' } }`.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-unifi--manage_defaults"></a>`manage_defaults`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to write `/etc/default/unifi`, which the service and the
package's scripts read for environment variables.

Default value: `false`

##### <a name="-unifi--defaults"></a>`defaults`

Data type: `Unifi::Environment`

Variables for `/etc/default/unifi`, such as
`{ 'JVM_MAX_HEAP_SIZE' => 2048, 'UNIFI_JVM_EXTRA_OPTS' => '-Dlog4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true' }`.
`JVM_INIT_HEAP_SIZE` and `JVM_MAX_HEAP_SIZE` are in MB. The package's unit
splits the JVM options at whitespace, so no single option can contain a
space.

Default value: `{}`

##### <a name="-unifi--manage_logrotate"></a>`manage_logrotate`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to manage `/etc/logrotate.d/unifi`, which rotates the MongoDB log
UniFi keeps in its logs directory. UniFi rotates its own `server.log`.

Default value: `true`

##### <a name="-unifi--logrotate_rotate"></a>`logrotate_rotate`

Data type: `Integer[0]`

How many rotated logs to keep.

Default value: `5`

##### <a name="-unifi--logrotate_size"></a>`logrotate_size`

Data type: `Pattern[/\A\d+[kMG]?\z/]`

Rotate when the log is larger than this, such as `50M`.

Default value: `'50M'`

##### <a name="-unifi--logrotate_compress"></a>`logrotate_compress`

Data type: `Boolean`

Whether to compress rotated logs.

Default value: `true`

## Defined types

### <a name="unifi--setting"></a>`unifi::setting`

UniFi reads `system.properties` when it starts, so a change restarts the
service (when the module manages it).

#### Examples

##### Move the device inform port

```puppet
unifi::setting { 'unifi.http.port':
  value => '8081',
}
```

##### Remove a property

```puppet
unifi::setting { 'unifi.https.port':
  ensure => absent,
}
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `unifi::setting` defined type:

* [`ensure`](#-unifi--setting--ensure)
* [`value`](#-unifi--setting--value)
* [`property`](#-unifi--setting--property)

##### <a name="-unifi--setting--ensure"></a>`ensure`

Data type: `Enum['present', 'absent']`

`present` sets the property to `value`; `absent` removes it.

Default value: `'present'`

##### <a name="-unifi--setting--value"></a>`value`

Data type: `Optional[Variant[String, Integer, Boolean]]`

The property's value. Required unless `ensure` is `absent`.

Default value: `undef`

##### <a name="-unifi--setting--property"></a>`property`

Data type: `String[1]`

The property name. Defaults to the resource title.

Default value: `$title`
